jobs_results.title: Desarrollador/a Python con experiencia en Ansible.
jobs_results.description:
¡En Qindel Group estamos creciendo!

Por ello, estamos buscamos un/a desarrollador/a Python altamente motivado y experimentado para unirse a nuestro equipo con conocimientos en Ansible. En este rol, serás responsable de diseñar, implementar y mantener soluciones automatizadas utilizando tecnologías clave como Python, Ansible y Powershell.

Entre tus funciones se encontrarán las siguientes:
• Desarrollar y mantener scripts y herramientas en Python para automatizar tareas de infraestructura.
• Diseñar, implementar y mantener flujos de trabajo automatizados utilizando Ansible.
• Colaborar con equipos de desarrollo y operaciones para mejorar la eficiencia y confiabilidad de la infraestructura.
• Crear scripts en Powershell para tareas específicas de administración en entornos Windows.
• Participar en la resolución de problemas y brindar soporte técnico cuando sea necesario.
• Generar documentación del código así como documentación de proyecto para entrega a cliente final.
• Nuestra... filosofía se centra en equipos dinámicos, con autonomía, y en los que fluya la comunicación. Para conseguirlo, solemos trabajar con equipos medianos o pequeños, horarios continuados, estructuras horizontales, y bajo metodologías ágiles.

¿Qué te podemos ofrecer?
• Contrato indefinido.
• Horario continuo: de 08:00 a 16:15 de lun-jue; 08:00 a 15:00 viernes.
• Teletrabajo.
• Seguro médico privado, seguro dental, de vida y accidentes.
• Formación bonificada adaptada a tus necesidades.
• Salario competitivo, basado en tu formación y experiencia.

Requisitos mínimos

Requisitos:

Estudios:

Ingeniería en computación, licenciaturas o grados afines.

Es importante:
• Al menos 3 años de experiencia comprobada en el desarrollo con Python.
• Experiencia sólida en la implementación de automatización de infraestructura con Ansible.
• Conocimientos prácticos de Powershell para administración de sistemas Windows.
• Experiencia en la integración de herramientas y flujos de trabajo en entornos de desarrollo y operaciones (DevOps).
• Familiaridad con tecnologías relacionadas con la nube (preferiblemente AWS, Azure o Google Cloud Platform).
• Capacidad para trabajar de manera independiente y colaborativa en un entorno ágil.
• Capacidad para generar documentación de alta calidad tanto a nivel código, como a nivel documentación de entrega de proyecto

jobs_results.title: Quant Developer in Python and C++ - SCIB
jobs_results.description:
Country: Spain

SCIB Markets is seeking a talented Quant Developer in Python and C++ with strong ability, interest and experience in design, development of libraries and DevOps to join our growing team of quants "Linear Rates, Inflation and Pricing Tools", focused on developing and maintaining pricing libraries for linear interest rates, inflation models, and pricing & risk tools for Trading, Sales, and Risk areas. The position is based in our headquarters in Boadilla del Monte, Madrid.

WHY YOU SHOULD CONSIDER THIS OPPORTUNITY

At Santander CIB (www.santandercib.com) we are key players in the transformation of the financial sector. Do you want to join us?

Santander Corporate & Investment Banking (Santander CIB) is Santander's global division that supports some of the world's most complex and sophisticated corporate and institutional clients, offering customized services and value-added wholesale products to best meet their needs.

We embrace a strong risk culture and all of our... professionals at all levels are expected to take a proactive and responsible approach toward risk management.

Santander is proud of being an organization where there are equal opportunities regardless of gender identity, culture and disability. Our mission is to contribute to help more people and business prosper.

We are seeking a talented Quantitative Developer with strong ability, interest, and experience in DevOps to join our growing team of quants "Linear Rates, Inflation and Pricing Tools", focused on developing and maintaining pricing libraries for linear interest rates, inflation models, and pricing & risk tools for Trading, Sales, and Risk areas.

What You Will Be Doing

As a Quant Developer in Python and C++ you will play a key role in designing, implementing, and optimizing the tools and quants libraries, ensuring they meet the highest standards of quality and performance.

We need someone like you to help us in different fronts:
• Contribute to the design, implementation, and maintenance of our C++ and Python pricing libraries.
• Maintain Jenkins and ensure the quality of software developed by the team.
• Lead and guide the team in adopting agile development practices, such as TDD, CI, and CD.
• Work with the team to enhance their “Git skills” and encourage the adoption of best practices.
• Establish and maintain code quality standards.
• Foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement within the team.
• Collaborate with the team to identify and eliminate bottlenecks in the development process.
• Develop and optimize algorithms for performance and efficiency.
• Refine existing quantitative frameworks and tools to ensure they adhere to best practices.
• Develop, improve, and maintain robust testing processes for our quantitative libraries and tools.
• Stay up to date with the latest advancements in technology relevant to the role.

Other potential activities to develop:
• Develop an efficient risk framework utilizing advanced techniques like Automatic Differentiation (AD) to accurately represent risks.
• Design and extend APIs for our pricing and curves libraries.
• Provide clear and concise mathematical and technical documentation for internal stakeholders.
• Collaborate and provide support to Trading, Sales, and Risk areas.
• Stay up to date with the latest developments in mathematics.

Experience
• Experience in Rust is highly valued.
• At least 3+ years of experience programming in C++ and/or Python, with a strong understanding of object-oriented programming principles.
• At least 1+ years of experience in DevOps tools ( Jenkins , testing fwks, automatic build ).
• Experience working with or as part of a quant team is desirable.

EDUCATION

Master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related quantitative field.

Skills & Knowledge

Required Skills & Experience:
• Strong complex-problem-solving skills with the ability to creatively approach new challenges.
• Knowledge of software engineering principles (SOLID, DDD).
• Understanding of DevOps practices and tools (Jenkins, build automation).
• Familiarity with compilers (gcc, clang, visual studio) and build tools (cmake).
• Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

Desired Skills:
• Experience with Rust programming language.
• Experience with at least some of the key activities mentioned above is a plus.
• Experience implementing complex mathematical algorithms and models, even in other industries.

Other Information
• Be part of an international team with colleagues in Madrid, London, New York.
• Collaborate and interact with other quants teams across the world.
• Provide functionality and service to Markets area worldwide

If you want to know more about us, follow us on:

https://www.linkedin.com/company/santander-corporate-investment-banking/

https://es.linkedin.com/company/banco-santanderhttps://es.linkedin.com/company/banco-santander

jobs_results.title: Python - Elixir Backend Engineer
jobs_results.description:
¿Quieres aprender a desarrollar en Elixir?

Desde e-Frontiers estamos buscando profesionales con perfil fullstack con experiencia en Python, RoR, Go, o Erlang...en desarrollo web y/o de software, y que quieran familiarizarse y trabajar con Elixir. Estamos ayudando a una empresa tecnológica de producto propio cuya herramienta ayuda al crecimiento de empresas, webs y comercios electrónicos (contratación directa con cliente final).

Funciones:
• Trabajarás en el equipo de desarrollo, principalmente donde además aprenderás a desarrollar con Elixir y utilizar otras tecnologías como AWS y Phoenix .
• Muchos de sus servicios están basados en Python o RoR, por lo que si tienes experiencia con alguno de estos lenguajes será un plus.
• Contribuir al desarrollo del sistema ayudando en su diseño e implementación.
• Garantizar el trabajo en equipo.

Requisitos:
• Al menos 4 años de experiencia en backend con alguno de estos lenguajes: Python, RoR, Erlang, Go...
• Interés y motivación por aprender... Elixir.
• Experiencia en front: JS, HTML, CSS...
• Nivel de inglés medio: suficiente para entender documentación técnica y poder intercambiar emails.

Valorable:
• Muy valorable experiencia previa en Python, Elixir, Erlang, Phoenix, RoR...
• Muy valorable experiencia con AWS.
• Experiencia en proyectos basados en microservicios.
• Experiencia en UX sería un plus.

Condiciones:
• Contrato indefinido y directo con cliente final.
• Seguro de salud.
• Modelo de trabajo remoto o híbrido en base a tus necesidades.
• Horario flexible.
• Actividades de formación para equipos.
• Salario: 35.000€ - 55.000 € en base a años de experiencia (aunque la franja es negociable).

¿Quieres saber un poco más? Inscríbete y te llamaremos para entrar en detalles

We manage more than 300 Mobile Apps & Games for other companies that are daily discovered by millions of new users and that have been downloaded hundreds of millions of times. We are looking for a CRO Manager!

• Technical degree preferred.
• Development projects techniques and skills; mainly phyton, kubernetes, mongodb, redis.

• Knowledge of app mobile industry

We don't offer remote or hybrid work, it is 100% face-to-face (Nuevos Ministerios, 28020, Madrid

jobs_results.title: Senior Python Developer - Innovative IoT Solutions
jobs_results.description:
Description

Worldsensing products have been pioneering the industrial IoT since 2008. We’re looking for a stand-out Software Engineer to join the Engineering department in our Barcelona office.

About Worldsensing

Founded in 2008, Worldsensing works with more than 300 engineering partners worldwide to improve geotechnical, geospatial and structural monitoring in mining, construction, rail and critical infrastructure management.

With over 1,000 monitoring networks deployed worldwide and connecting over 65,000 sensors to the Internet of Things, our Loadsensing solution is the leader in the IoT remote monitoring space.

The Loadsensing monitoring solution includes best-in-class edge devices and LoRa-based connectivity products. We also join forces with key industry players to offer software applications and solutions which engineering service providers use to add value to end customers.

The Mission:

The Software Engineer is a critical role in WorldSensing. This role’s primary focus... is the development, definition, and deployment of software solutions for our products, whilst ensuring high performance and responsiveness to requests from and to these products.

Responsibilities:
• Design, development, and delivery of the company’s core platform and cloud applications, making sure our applications function properly (including scalability, efficiency, resilience, fault tolerance, and data security techniques).
• Work closely with other engineers & designers, product owners, and other team members to implement complex end-to-end systems.
• Use technical skills to close the gaps between new requirements and Worldsensing products.
• Build reusable code and libraries for future use.
• Rigorous commitment to documentation, quality engineering, testing, and support.
• Perform code reviews for other software engineers and provide feedback.
• On-call support may be required to support a 24/7 online service.
• Collaborate and help in the definition of European Union Innovation projects.

Requirements
• 5+ years of software development experience in back-end services.
• 3+ years with Python using FastAPI framework.
• Experience with Java, React and TypeScript is a plus.
• Experience with advanced programming frameworks and paradigms.
• Good experience with Linux environments.
• Experience with Docker.
• Experience with Kubernetes is a plus.
• Basic networking knowledge.
• Proficient understanding of code versioning tools, preferably Git.
• You're passionate about IoT & technical challenges. There should be something you know more about than anyone on our team.
• Strong analysis and practical problem-solving abilities to resolve challenging situations.
• You communicate with clarity and precision. We care about this almost as much as your technical ability.
• You’re an empathetic person who is comfortable with changes and is an incredibly fast learner and has a can-do, roll-up-your-sleeves attitude.
• BS degree in a technical field or equivalent experience.
• A good level of spoken and written English is required.

Competencies:
• Be able to develop in different programming languages.
• Ability to organize work with little day-to-day direction.
• Track record of flexibility in response to changing circumstances.
• A good team player with excellent verbal and written skills along with a strong commercial focus.
• A can-do, roll-up-your-sleeves attitude.
• Passion for your work and a sense of humor.

Benefits
• Great work environment: we are a passionate, tight-knit team hailing from 20+ countries
• We are a family-friendly company and support a healthy work-life balance, we’re outcome oriented
• Work-from-home policy (flexibility)
• We like grabbing lunch or a drink together, and coming together for fun events organized by Worldsensing
• We love to learn and we love to share so you will actively participate in our knowledge sharing initiatives or transversal committees (communities, show and tell, etc.)
• You can expect a competitive compensation package
• Opportunity to work for a global IoT player which has been labeled as one of the organizations actively shaping and pioneering the Industrial Internet
• Hybrid working environment

At Worldsensing, we’re committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We strive to be a more equal opportunity workplace

jobs_results.title: Python Developer (Senior)
jobs_results.description:
Seleccionamos Senior Python Developer para formar parte de nuestro equipo.

Esta es una buena oportunidad para seguir avanzando en tu carrera profesional :)

Requisito indispensable:
• Tener 4 o más años de experiencia desarrollando con Python.

Valorables conocimientos en:
• Redes (CCNA)
• Automatización
• Ansible
• Herramientas DevOps

¿Qué puedes esperar tú de nosotros?

- Formarás parte de una compañía en desarrollo y crecimiento, donde la tecnología y la innovación se unen a través de las personas que la conformamos, con un componente internacional y multicultural que hace del día a día una gran experiencia.

- Compartirás proyectos con gurús de las tecnologías más punteras, ¿qué hay mejor que aprender y compartir conocimiento con los mejores?

- Si ya estás certificado, mejor que mejor para poner en juego todo lo que hayas aprendido. Si no lo estás, te invitamos a hacerlo desde el momento en que entres en la compañía y el límite lo pones tú.

- Disfrutarás de un ambiente de... trabajo genial.

Y además, la experiencia en NTT te ofrece:

- Contamos con 26 días laborables de vacaciones al año y además el día del cumpleaños.

- Dispondrás de Tarjeta Restaurante para poder comer fuera cuando no tengas ganas de cocinar.

- Y además, puedes contar con otra serie de beneficios en retribución flexible como el Ticket Transporte, Seguro Médico, cheque guardería, descuentos en restaurantes a empleados, etc.

Únete a nuestro equipo global en expansión y acelera el crecimiento de tu carrera con NTT Ldt.

¡Envíanos tu candidatura y no olvides aplicar con tu CV
